# gpupaas Provider

Provider for the GPU PaaS platform. Configure the endpoint and credentials (or leave the block empty and set the `GPUPAAS_*` environment variables), then manage virtual machines, bare-metal machines and Kubernetes (MKS) clusters from the platform's SKUs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.5.0"

  required_providers {
    gpupaas = {
      source  = "gpupaas-ai/gpupaas"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

# All attributes are optional; explicit values override the corresponding
# environment variables (GPUPAAS_ENDPOINT, GPUPAAS_API_KEY / GPUPAAS_TOKEN,
# GPUPAAS_USER_AGENT). Endpoint defaults to https://console.gpupaas.ai.
provider "gpupaas" {
  endpoint   = "https://console.gpupaas.ai"
  token      = var.gpupaas_token
  user_agent = "my-team/1.0"
}

variable "gpupaas_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the GPU PaaS API. Defaults to `https://console.gpupaas.ai`. Falls back to `GPUPAAS_ENDPOINT`.
- `insecure` (Boolean) Skip TLS certificate verification. Intended only for test environments with self-signed certificates. Falls back to `GPUPAAS_INSECURE` (`true`/`1`). Defaults to `false`.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization the API key acts in: its id or its exact, case-sensitive name, sent as the `X-Organization-ID` header. Leave it unset with an organization-level API key, which is bound to its organization (the platform ignores the value for such a key). A partner-level API key is not bound to an organization and must set it; the organization must belong to the key's partner. Falls back to `GPUPAAS_ORGANIZATION_ID`.
- `request_timeout` (String) Time limit for one API request, as a duration such as `90s` or `2m`. Defaults to `30s`. Raise it for very large clusters, whose responses take longer. It limits a single request: how long an operation may run is set by the `timeouts` block of each resource. Falls back to `GPUPAAS_REQUEST_TIMEOUT`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) API token used for authentication. Falls back to `GPUPAAS_API_KEY`, then `GPUPAAS_TOKEN`.
- `user_agent` (String) Custom User-Agent suffix appended to outbound API requests. Falls back to `GPUPAAS_USER_AGENT`.
